خَاِدجٌ A she-camel (or a female of another kind, TA) casting her young one before the completion of the days [of gestation], (S, A, K,) even if it be completely formed; (S, A;) as also ↓ خَدُوجٌ , of which the pl. is خُدُوجٌ and خِدَاجٌ and خَدَائِجُ: or a she-camel casting her young one in a defective state, before the time. (TA. [See 1, of which it is the act. part. n. And see also مُخْدِجٌ.]) ―
-b2- [Hence,] (tropical:) A man deficient in a limb, or member. (A. [See also مُخْدَجٌ.]) صَلَاةٌ خَادِجَةٌ: see خِدَاجٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
